d:
Amerika men 3 navanbar ko hone ja rahe midtarm chunavon se demokretik parti ko kaphi ummiden hain. ek taraf ripablikan rashtrapti donald tranp ki lokapriyta aitihasik rup se kafi kam hai. dusri taraf khane-pine ki chizon aur rozmarra ke bilon ki barhti qimton se ameriki janta naraz hai. pichhle kaee mahinon se aa rahe pol sarve bhi demokrets ke anukul hain jo unke lie achchhi khabar ka sanket de rahe hain. lekin kya bazi palat bhi sakti hai? pol sarve kya vakaee men sahi sabit honge?
